name: heatmapy
description: Overlay your Strava global and personal heatmaps on Mapy.com, and send planned routes to Strava.

scripts.zip: npm run build && cd dist/chrome && zip -qr ../../heatmapy-chrome.zip ./* && cd ../firefox && zip -qr ../../heatmapy-firefox.zip ./* && echo 'wrote heatmapy-chrome.zip + heatmapy-firefox.zip'
scripts.lint:firefox: npm run build:firefox && npx --yes web-ext@8 lint --source-dir dist/firefox
scripts.start:firefox: npm run build:firefox && npx --yes web-ext@8 run --source-dir dist/firefox --start-url https://mapy.com/

author: Matyáš Strelec
